structure.layout: single-viewport centered splash: full-bleed animated WebGL fluid canvas, particle wordmark, two-line tagline, 4-digit code entry, icon row and credit line, all center-stacked

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack (rendered as DejaVu Sans Bold) throughout. Tagline is 48px/700 with wide letter-spacing; the hint and credits are 15px/600, also widely tracked. The 'ZestSend' wordmark is drawn as particles on a canvas.
aesthetics.typeScale: Large canvas wordmark (~130px tall), then a 48px bold tracked tagline, then 15px semi-bold hint and credits. Strong contrast between the two levels and almost no middle tier.

notes: The whole page is one interactive screen. Behind everything is an animated WebGL fluid/smoke simulation in deep navy and cyan. The 'ZestSend' wordmark is rendered as noisy particles on its own canvas. In the tagline, 'Anonymously ___' is typed out in rotation ('write together' with a Markdown icon, 'share a folder' with a folder icon, 'chat in real time'), with 'end-to-end encryption 🔒' fixed in mint green. The only real control is a 4-digit connection code made of underline-only boxes: entered digits and their underlines turn mint green, and letters are rejected. The footer has three line icons (globe, gear, info) that open centered glassy dialogs on a blurred backdrop. The Appearance dialog offers 7+ named color themes ('Midnight Drift', 'Signal Mint', 'Solar Ember'…), each with a witty subtitle and a three-swatch strip. Each credit link's text appears doubled in the a11y tree, which suggests a text-scramble/hover animation. No header or navbar.
